existence.Init(a): The first event of the trace is a.
existence.AtLeastOne(a): Activity a occurs at least once in the trace.
existence.AtMostOne(a): Activity a occurs at most once in the trace; zero occurrences are allowed.
existence.End(a): The last event of the trace is a.

relation.RespondedExistence(a,b): If a occurs anywhere in the trace, b also occurs somewhere in the trace; there is no temporal ordering requirement.
relation.Response(a,b): Every occurrence of a is followed by a later occurrence of b.
relation.AlternateResponse(a,b): Every a is followed by b before another a occurs.
relation.ChainResponse(a,b): Every a is immediately followed by b as the next event of the trace.
relation.Precedence(a,b): Every b has an earlier a in the trace; a need not be followed by b.
relation.AlternatePrecedence(a,b): Every b has an earlier a, with no other b between that a and b.
relation.ChainPrecedence(a,b): Every b is immediately preceded by a as the previous event of the trace.

mutual.CoExistence(a,b): a occurs if and only if b occurs; either both occur or neither occurs, with no ordering requirement.

negative.NotCoExistence(a,b): a and b never both occur in the same trace. Neither activity is required to occur.
negative.NotSuccession(a,b): No b occurs after any a. This is directional; b before a is allowed.
negative.NotChainSuccession(a,b): No a is immediately followed by b. This is directional; b immediately followed by a is allowed.
